aka.zh: 坦皮科—纳维达德湾公路

aka.en: Carretera Guadalajara–Barra de Navidad (the Jalisco coast road)
aka.zh: 瓜达拉哈拉—纳维达德湾公路（哈利斯科海岸公路）

tagline.en: From the Gulf at Tampico across the middle of the country by San Luis Potosí and Guadalajara to the Pacific at Barra de Navidad
tagline.zh: 从墨西哥湾畔的坦皮科出发，经圣路易斯波托西和瓜达拉哈拉横穿国土中部，抵达太平洋岸的纳维达德湾

start.en: San Patricio Melaque, beside Barra de Navidad on the Jalisco coast, at the junction with Federal Highway 200
start.zh: 哈利斯科海岸纳维达德湾旁的圣帕特里西奥梅拉克，与 200 号联邦公路交会

end.en: Altamira, Tamaulipas, on the northern edge of the Tampico conurbation
end.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州阿尔塔米拉，坦皮科都市区北缘

en: Federal Highway 80 crosses Mexico from the Gulf to the Pacific. From the Tampico area it runs west by González to Ciudad Mante and Antiguo Morelos, climbs the Sierra Madre Oriental by El Naranjo and Ciudad del Maíz, and crosses the plateau to San Luis Potosí. From there it runs south-west by Villa de Arriaga and Ojuelos into the Altos de Jalisco by Lagos de Moreno, San Juan de los Lagos and Tepatitlán to Guadalajara, and then south-west again by Cocula, Autlán and La Huerta to the coast at Melaque and Barra de Navidad.

English Wikipedia, from the ministry's 2011 traffic tables, gives 962.23 km. The route is not continuous: it shares the road with Highway 57 for 109.62 km between San Luis Potosí and El Huizache, and with Highway 85 for 31.1 km between Antiguo Morelos and Ciudad Mante.
zh: 80 号联邦公路从墨西哥湾横穿到太平洋。它从坦皮科一带向西，经冈萨雷斯到曼特城和安蒂瓜莫雷洛斯，经埃尔纳兰霍和玉米城爬上东马德雷山脉，再横越高原到圣路易斯波托西。由此向西南，经比利亚德阿里亚加和奥胡埃洛斯进入哈利斯科高地，经拉戈斯德莫雷诺、圣胡安德洛斯拉戈斯和特帕蒂特兰到瓜达拉哈拉，然后再向西南，经科库拉、奥特兰和拉韦尔塔抵达梅拉克和纳维达德湾的海岸。
英文维基百科依据交通部 2011 年交通数据表，给出 962.23 公里。线路并不连续：在圣路易斯波托西至埃尔韦萨切之间与 57 号公路共线 109.62 公里，在安蒂瓜莫雷洛斯至曼特城之间与 85 号公路共线 31.1 公里。

en: The western end grew out of Guadalajara's search for its own coast. A road from Guadalajara to Autlán was inaugurated on 24 February 1935, according to the Autlán cultural site CulturAutlán. In the 1950s the state government under Agustín Yáñez promoted the colonisation of the Jalisco coast, and the road from Autlán to Barra de Navidad was built and paved in 1956 and 1957, in step with the manganese mining of the Compañía Minera Autlán; a study of the colonisation quotes the boast that it went forward at ‘a kilometre a day’.

The ministry's magazine El Mirador records that the 312.3 km from Guadalajara to Barra de Navidad were finished under the 1959 public works programme, giving the city its first road to the sea that did not leave the state; the road was later extended north-east to Tampico. University of Guadalajara television dates the road's inauguration to 1960.
zh: 西段源于瓜达拉哈拉寻找自己出海口的努力。据奥特兰文化网站 CulturAutlán，瓜达拉哈拉至奥特兰的公路于 1935 年 2 月 24 日落成。1950 年代，阿古斯丁·亚涅斯主政的州政府推动哈利斯科海岸的垦殖，奥特兰至纳维达德湾的公路于 1956 和 1957 年修建并铺装，与奥特兰矿业公司的锰矿开采同步推进；一份关于这段垦殖史的研究引述了当时“一天一公里”的夸耀。
交通部刊物《El Mirador》记载，瓜达拉哈拉至纳维达德湾的 312.3 公里在 1959 年公共工程计划中完工，使这座城市第一次有了一条不出州境就能通往海边的公路；这条路后来向东北延伸到坦皮科。瓜达拉哈拉大学电视台把公路落成定在 1960 年。

en: El Mirador puts the 1959 work on the Guadalajara–Barra de Navidad road at 14.8 million pesos, of which 7.8 million was federal and the rest came from the state of Jalisco. It sets this in a wider programme: about 700 km of federal roads built in Jalisco from 1952 to 1958 for about 200 million pesos. On the coast section, the study of the colonisation quotes the claim that the Autlán–Barra de Navidad road was paved ‘exclusively’ at the expense of private parties.
zh: 《El Mirador》称，1959 年瓜达拉哈拉—纳维达德湾公路的工程耗资 1,480 万比索，其中联邦出资 780 万，其余来自哈利斯科州。它将此放在更大的计划中：1952 至 1958 年间，哈利斯科州共修建联邦公路约 700 公里，耗资约 2 亿比索。至于海岸段，那份垦殖史研究引述的说法是，奥特兰—纳维达德湾公路的铺装“完全”由私人出资。

value.en: 962.23 km, including 109.62 km shared with Highway 57 and 31.1 km shared with Highway 85
value.zh: 962.23 公里，其中与 57 号公路共线 109.62 公里，与 85 号公路共线 31.1 公里

figures.source: SCT, Datos Viales 2011, as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 80

why.en: No total has been found for the whole road, which was built in pieces. The only figure found is 14.8 million pesos for the 1959 work on Guadalajara–Barra de Navidad, given below.
why.zh: 这条路分段修建，未找到全线总造价。所见唯一的数字是 1959 年瓜达拉哈拉—纳维达德湾公路工程的 1,480 万比索，见下。

value.en: Federal and state: of the 14.8 million pesos spent in 1959 on Guadalajara–Barra de Navidad, 7.8 million was federal and the rest from Jalisco. The Autlán–Barra de Navidad section (1956–1957) was reported paved at private expense; not checked against state accounts
value.zh: 联邦与州共同出资：1959 年瓜达拉哈拉—纳维达德湾公路投入的 1,480 万比索中，联邦 780 万，其余来自哈利斯科州。据报道，奥特兰—纳维达德湾段（1956—1957）由私人出资铺装；未与州政府账目核对

figures.source: SCT, El Mirador, “Jalisco y sus carreteras en los años cincuenta”; study of the colonisation of the Jalisco coast, 1953–1959, on Dialnet

label.zh: 瓜达拉哈拉—纳维达德湾段

value.en: 312.3 km, finished under the 1959 public works programme
value.zh: 312.3 公里，在 1959 年公共工程计划中完工

figures.source: SCT, El Mirador, “Jalisco y sus carreteras en los años cincuenta”

value.en: Reported as 1960 by University of Guadalajara television; not checked against SCT records
value.zh: 据瓜达拉哈拉大学电视台为 1960 年；未与交通部记录核对

figures.source: UDG TV, report on Federal Highway 80

timeline.en: The Guadalajara–Autlán road is inaugurated on 24 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 24 日，瓜达拉哈拉—奥特兰公路落成。

timeline.en: Jalisco begins a six-year programme that builds about 700 km of federal roads.
timeline.zh: 哈利斯科州开始为期六年的计划，共修建联邦公路约 700 公里。

timeline.en: Construction of the Autlán–Barra de Navidad road begins.
timeline.zh: 奥特兰—纳维达德湾公路开工。

timeline.en: The Autlán–Barra de Navidad road is paved.
timeline.zh: 奥特兰—纳维达德湾公路铺装完成。

timeline.en: The 312.3 km from Guadalajara to Barra de Navidad are finished under the year's public works programme.
timeline.zh: 瓜达拉哈拉至纳维达德湾 312.3 公里在当年公共工程计划中完工。
